component.name: Fix My Linux
component.summary: Fix your computer by describing the problem

description.p: Describe a problem with your Linux computer in plain words, like "my Wi-Fi keeps dropping" or "my disk is full". An AI assistant runs the right terminal commands for you and explains each step in plain language.
It looks around freely, but it asks before changing anything, and it shows exactly what will run. Commands that need your password ask for it inside the app, naming the exact command.
